cards.claim: Toledo Q/R (information-discrete-math root extension): the package's own already-shipped finite-series/Newton readouts of pi, e, and sqrt(2) on the D->Z->Q->R number ladder agree with an independent oracle (mpmath) to a declared precision

preregistered_prediction.statement: For each of pi, sqrt(2), e: idm's own already-shipped finite readout (idm.pi() / idm.e() -- provefull/_kernel.py PI_FINITE/E_FINITE, from-scratch Machin-formula/Taylor-series arithmetic; cosmology.sqrt_finite(2) -- provefull/cosmology.py, from-scratch pure Newton-Raphson iteration, NOT mp.sqrt) agrees with an independent mpmath oracle computed separately at higher working precision (50 decimal digits) to at least 25 correct decimal digits (|delta| <= 1e-25). This tolerance is derived from a direct pre-run trace of the package's own ACTUAL working precision: provefull/_kernel.py opens with mp.mp.dps = 40, but its own later import of tools/idm_tools.py resets mp.mp.dps = 30 before PI_FINITE/E_FINITE/sqrt_finite are ever computed -- so the readouts actually run at 30 significant decimal digits, not 40; 25 is registered with real margin below that traced 30-digit floor, not tuned to any run's own output. Toledo codes Q (the rationals, field of fractions of Z) and R (the reals -- the continuum AS a readout, Def 3.4: Bishop regular Cauchy sequences of Q) are the D->Z->Q->R ladder objects this reproduction concerns; this card tests the package's Python-level finite-series/Newton arithmetic, not a claim that these specific readouts are Th_coqc-backed (Toledo's own docs/TOLEDO_CODES.md notes the R root is tiered '+R-axioms' in this repo's own Coq files for an unrelated reason -- importing Coq.Reals -- which this card's Python-only comparison does not touch either way).
preregistered_prediction.tolerance: exact categorical match (PASS/FAIL -- no numeric band): PASS iff each of pi, sqrt(2), e passes its own |delta| <= 1e-25 check against the independent mpmath oracle (see statement); reference value to pass at run time is the literal string PASS

oracle.source: mpmath (independent implementation, external to information-discrete-math's own from-scratch series/Newton code in provefull/_kernel.py and provefull/cosmology.py); pi()/e()/sqrt_finite() never call mpmath's own mp.pi/mp.e/mp.sqrt to produce their values -- mpf is used only as an arbitrary-precision finite-arithmetic engine, per those files' own docstrings
